issues.title: MariaDB replication blocker: crash-safe slave with parallel replication (MDEV-20821)
issues.description: Server {server_url} is running {flavor} {version} which is affected by MDEV-20821 — a critical replication blocker that can cause data loss or slave crash when using crash-safe parallel replication.

issues.title: MariaDB replication issue with non-ROW binlog format (MDEV-28310)
issues.description: Server {server_url} is running {flavor} {version} which is affected by MDEV-28310 — replication may silently produce incorrect results when using STATEMENT or MIXED binlog format.

remediations.description: Upgrade to MariaDB 10.2.44+ / 10.3.35+ / 10.4.25+ / 10.5.16+ / 10.6.8+ / 10.7.4+ / 10.8.3+ or switch to ROW binlog format.

issues.title: MariaDB AUTOINC + non-ROW replication issue (MDEV-19577)

remediations.description: Upgrade to MariaDB 10.3.35+ / 10.4.25+ / 10.5.16+ or set INNODB_AUTOINC_LOCK_MODE=1 or use ROW binlog format.
